value.rationale: A methodological distinction is established on a nonempty open parameter interval in a concrete family of smooth polynomial-flow limit cycles: the natural phase-alignment iteration is trapped at a genuine strict local mean despite there being at least three better, globally optimal, embedded mean shapes. Prior two-input constructions can only show a saddle-type fixed point or a twofold global bifurcation; proving strict local metastability in the full Hilbert quotient and symmetry-protected triple global ambiguity supplies an identifiable diagnostic limit for representative-trajectory estimation. No downstream theorem or exact global minimum is claimed; the structural obstruction itself is the motivated result.
